auto_dj.name: Auto DJ
auto_dj.bio: Trax Radio UK's automated music system, playing the best electronic and dance music 24/7. Curated playlists ensure continuous high-quality entertainment with seamless transitions and professional mixing.

live_djs.name: DJ Hicky
live_djs.bio: AKA The Preacher - Trax Radio UK's premier DJ with over 10 years of experience in electronic and dance music. Known for his energetic sets and deep knowledge of house, techno, and progressive genres.

live_djs.name: DJ Paddy
live_djs.bio: Trax Radio UK's resident DJ specializing in deep house and progressive beats. With a passion for underground sounds and smooth mixing, Paddy brings the perfect vibe for late-night listening.

live_djs.name: DJ Sidwayne
live_djs.bio: The master of electronic soundscapes and ambient beats. Sidwayne's sets take listeners on a journey through atmospheric music, perfect for those who appreciate the deeper side of electronic music.

live_djs.name: DJ Gary Hill
live_djs.bio: Trax Radio UK's veteran DJ with decades of experience in the electronic music scene. Gary's sets blend classic tracks with modern beats, creating a timeless listening experience.

live_djs.name: Stevie B
live_djs.bio: The rising star of Trax Radio UK, Stevie B brings fresh energy to the airwaves with his innovative mixing style and eclectic music selection. From deep house to tech house, he's got it covered.
